question: When Capella was dripping blood on Subaru, she said “The girl meat, too, will certainly die. It’s too unfortunate. That’s my favorite after all…. I wanted to test it. Whether it will lose to the blood. Ah, that’s right.” so I thought she wanted to drip blood on Crusch but hadn’t dripped it, but her next line “My blood is very different from anyone else’s. ‘Cause ya know, it’s got dragon blood mixed in it, after all. When you lose to the blood’s curse, it’s just incredible. Think you’ll last longer than the girl meat over there?” carried the nuance that she’d already dripped blood on Crusch, but had she dripped blood on her, or hadn’t she?
answer: She was dripped on at the moment her eyes first went white, so there she hadn’t been dripped on yet. She was dripped on a while ago.
